name: Shuffle
notes: Playful AI you text in iMessage or on the web: pictures, videos, music and games about your friends, or just talk; agents can build games and tools through its REST API and MCP. Site is textshuffle.com, app at addshuffle.com (shuffle.cool was the earlier domain).
tagline: The AI you open for fun

access.price: Free · Pro $8/mo (unlimited chat, 880 monthly credits) · Day pass $1 · Week pass $4.99
